propositions: Session-scoped run_request_sites fixture setup costs 46-53s per Ubuntu CI cell due to _enclosing repeatedly rebuilding parent maps and _verdict re-walking cached source trees for every parameter hop instead of indexing once

Instrumented cold-process profiling measured 9.6 million ast.walk node iterations and 130.9 million calls producing identical 24 ordered provenance tuples, proving graph structure is being recomputed rather than cached

Immutable per-process _AstIndex built once from already-cached parsed modules indexes parents, functions, and call sites; _enclosing, _verdict, and _run_request_sites query indices instead of re-traversing
Cold-scan time improved from 3.26s to 0.81s (4x) with ast iterations reduced from 9.6M to 569K while preserving exact 24 tuple order and all four guard verdicts
Deterministic oracle test_provenance_scan_preserves_verdicts_with_linear_whole_tree_work enforces <=3 whole-module walks and fails when per-lookup parent rebuilding is reintroduced
